cohort: 389 women with PPROM between 24 and 34 weeks of gestation
finding: Initial oligohydramnios after PPROM is associated with shorter latency to delivery, higher rate of clinical chorioamnionitis, higher rate of emergency cesarean delivery, and lower 1-minute Apgar score.
mod_finding: Higher rate of emergency cesarean delivery observed in the oligohydramnios group.
